# MX Royale

> MX Royale is a free motocross racing game that runs in the web browser. No download and no account are needed; it works on PC, Mac, phones and tablets with keyboard, touch controls or a gamepad. It has 15 race tracks (including supercross), 2 freeride maps, whips, scrubs and flips, races against AI, time trial with ghosts and online races with friends.

Also known as: MXRoyale

Last updated: 2026-11-27

## Facts

- Price: free. No ads, no in-game purchases.
- Platform: web browser (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari) on PC, Mac, phones and tablets. No download, no install.
- Controls: keyboard (remappable), touch controls in landscape with optional tilt steering, gamepad.
- Modes: race vs. up to 11 AI riders, time trial with ghost and medal times, Daily Challenge, Championship (4 races), freeride, trick school, online races with friends via a 5-character room code (bots can fill the field).
- Tracks: 15 race tracks + 2 freeride maps, including 2 supercross tracks.
- Tricks: whips, scrubs, backflips, Superman, Nac-Nac, Can-Can, heel clicker, seat grab, cliffhanger.
- Bikes: 450 four-stroke, 250 two-stroke, electric.
- Languages: English, German, Spanish, French, Brazilian Portuguese.
- Account: optional.
- Status: open beta since 2026-11-26.
- Developer: three students from Austria (hobby project).
- Play: https://play.mxroyale.com/
- Social: TikTok, Instagram and YouTube as @mxroyalegame.

## Tracks

- **Sunvale MX Park** (Beginner, Motocross): Most riders start here. Wide grassy turns, rollers and small tables lead over cow pastures and past hay bales, and one section runs straight through a creek. A good place to learn the pop and your first whips.
- **Larkmeadow SX** (Medium, Supercross): A short, tight supercross track under stadium lights. Rhythm lanes, a whoops section and a sand section come one after another, and the lap ends with an SX double and a triple over the finish line.
- **Frostline MX** (Medium, Snow): Frostline runs down a ski slope in winter: along the chairlift line, past snow cannons and over the Frozen Creek Gap. Snow rollers and a big jump into the finish straight close the lap.
- **Monsoon Terraces** (Medium, Motocross): A flowing layout on a terraced hillside. A chain of jumps drops from terrace to terrace, the track passes bamboo and runs along a wooden aqueduct. Rewards a smooth line more than raw speed.
- **Mirage Flats** (Medium–hard, Desert): A jump park in the desert. You clear the railway with the Rail Gap, hammer through a washboard section on the dry lake bed and finish with the Mirage table. Lots of air time, little room for mistakes on the landings.
- **Glutwald MX** (Medium–hard, Forest): An autumn forest track in low evening light. Three jumps have fire next to them, the climb has a big step-up and the descent a big step-down into the valley. Leaves, roots and rhythm sections in between.
- **Rustleaf Hollow** (Medium–hard, Forest): Narrow and twisty: Rustleaf winds through autumn woods over root carpets, through a muddy hollow, along a log-skidding lane and past an excavator. A track for precise steering rather than flat-out speed.
- **Neon Harbor SX** (Medium–hard, Supercross): The second supercross track sits in a harbour hall at night. You jump a table built from shipping containers, turn under a crane, fight through the dock whoops and go for the Harbor Triple.
- **Pine Ridge GP** (Hard, Grand Prix): A classic outdoor Grand Prix through pine forest. The track climbs Horsepower Hill, runs along the ridge over roots and doubles and comes back down through the woods. Long laps, a full gate of 12 riders.
- **Sandglass Canyon GP** (Hard, Canyon): Sandglass takes you through red desert canyons. Rock steps and slabs, a table on top of a mesa, a narrow slot canyon, a drop off a cliff and a Road Gap over the highway, then back down the wash through the whoops.
- **Highcrest Valley GP** (Hard, Mountain): The fastest outdoor track: Highcrest climbs 38 metres through forest and rock, over limestone slabs and up switchbacks to the summit, then drops through a rock gate and past a waterfall.
- **Canopy Hollow** (Hard, Rainforest): A twisting rainforest track down in a hollow. Jump a canyon gap, cross a suspension bridge, ride through a tunnel of trees and past a waterfall, and keep your balance on the dragon’s back.
- **Tidewater Flats** (Hard, Beach): Sand riding on the coast at low tide. Ripples and soft sand everywhere, a gap over a tidal creek, a turn by the lighthouse, a lane between the groynes and a line straight through an old shipwreck.
- **Ironcut Quarry** (Hard, Quarry): Ironcut climbs a disused quarry in switchbacks from terrace to terrace. On top you ride a dragon’s back along the rim before a steep drop back down into the pit.
- **Saltpan Speedway** (Hard, Salt lake): Wide open and fast: Saltpan crosses a salt lake with long straights and rollers. The highlights are the Salt Crust Triple and a table next to the salt works’ conveyor belt.
- **Dust Devil Freeride** (Freeride, Freeride): No laps, no timer, no opponents. Dust Devil is an open map with jump lines, a step-up, a hip and a foam pit to practise tricks without consequences.
- **Midnight Arena** (Freeride, Freestyle): A freestyle motocross show at night in a stadium. Separate ramps for whips, backflips, Nac-Nacs, Can-Cans and big air, plus a quarterpipe and fireworks.

## Controls

### Keyboard

W/S throttle/brake · A/D steer (in the air: whip) · ←/→ lean the bike (scrub, lay it flat) · ↑/↓ weight forward/back · Space crouch/pop · Shift rear brake · R respawn · C camera · Q look back · G ghost · Esc pause. All riding keys can be remapped.

### Phone (landscape)

Left thumb: a stick appears where you touch (steer, weight). Right thumb: hold GAS, brake to its left; drag left/right on the throttle to lean (scrub), drag down and release at the lip to pop. Optional tilt steering in Settings.

### Gamepad

RT throttle, LT brake (analog) · left stick steer/whip · right stick weight and lean · A crouch/pop · X rear brake · Y respawn · Start pause · freeride tricks: hold LB or RB + left stick.

### Whip, scrub, gate start

Whip: steer in just before the lip, hold in the air, let go about half a second before landing. Scrub: lay the bike down on the ramp face and stand it up before the end of the lip. Gate start: hold throttle and brake from the "5" board, release the brake when the gate drops.

## FAQ

### Is MX Royale free?

Yes, MX Royale is completely free to play. There are no ads and no in-game purchases.

### Is there a free motocross game I can play online without downloading?

Yes. MX Royale is a free motocross and dirt bike game that runs in the browser on PC and phones, with no download and no account.

### Do I need to download or install MX Royale?

No, MX Royale runs directly in the web browser with no download and no install. It works in Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari, and no account is needed to start riding.

### Can I play MX Royale on my phone?

Yes, MX Royale works on phones and tablets in landscape mode. It has touch controls with a thumb stick, throttle and brake buttons, and optional tilt steering.

### Does MX Royale support a controller?

Yes, MX Royale supports gamepads. Throttle and brake are on the analog triggers (RT/LT), the left stick steers and whips, and the right stick moves your weight and leans the bike.

### Can I race my friends online in MX Royale?

Yes, MX Royale has online races with room codes. One player creates a room and shares the 5-character code, the others enter it and the track loads automatically; bots can fill up the field.

### How many tracks does MX Royale have?

MX Royale has 15 race tracks and 2 freeride maps. They include two supercross tracks and outdoor tracks in forest, desert, canyon, snow, rainforest, beach, quarry and salt-lake settings.

### Is there supercross in MX Royale?

Yes, MX Royale has two supercross tracks: Larkmeadow SX in a night stadium and Neon Harbor SX in a harbour hall. Both have rhythm sections, whoops and triples.

### Which game modes does MX Royale have?

MX Royale has races against AI riders, time trial with your own ghost, a Daily Challenge, a Championship of four races, freeride, a trick school and online races with friends.

### Which languages is MX Royale available in?

MX Royale is available in English, German, Spanish, French and Brazilian Portuguese.

### Is MX Royale like MX Bikes or MX vs ATV?

MX Bikes and MX vs ATV are games you download for PC or consoles. MX Royale is an arcade motocross game that runs free in the browser, with supercross tracks, whips and online races; it is less of a simulator.

### Who makes MX Royale?

MX Royale is made by three students from Austria who ride motocross themselves. It is a hobby project in open beta.
